I can't see my language in the app!
Currently, our application is available in 3 languages, namely Romanian, English and Hungarian.

Calendar.Title: How can I see the calendar for my address?
Calendar.Content:
How can I see the calendar for my address?
In order to view the calendar associated with your primary address, you must have a valid address in your account. To do this, go to Profile -> Account Details -> My addresses -> Add new address.

CalendarDates.Title: The calendar does not include the actual colection dates. How can I get the right data?
CalendarDates.Content:
The calendar does not include the actual colection dates. How can I get the right data?
There may be several reasons that could justify the appearance of this error, for example:
1. If you live in an apartment or condominium, where the waste is collected in common bins, you will find a special calendar because you always have the opportunity of depositing waste in the common bins. This element can be added to your address by checking the special box: 'I live in a block'.
2. If you live in a house and you have your own bins but the collection calendar does not correspond to what the system gives you, please contact us so that we can correct this error.
We are constantly working to improve the application, so all feedback is well recieved and important to us.

InvalidStreet.Title: Although I have selected the town where I live, I cannot find the exact street. How do I proceed?
InvalidStreet.Content:
Although I have selected the town where I live, I cannot find the exact street. How do I proceed?
1. There is a possibility that the street nomenclature from your locality has not yet entered our database. The database is continuously being updated. If you experience this situation, please contact us about this issue so we can fix it.
2. If you live in the municipality of Oradea, the street nomenclature is being continuously updated, and will be fully completed by April 30, 2023.
We apologize in advance for any discomfort we may have caused. Thank you for your patience and understanding!

Centres.Title: How can I see the collection centres around me?
Centres.Content:
How can I see the collection centres around me?
To see the collection points around you, go to the Map section. Optionally, you can filter these centres by clicking on the filter button in the bottom right corner and selecting the desired waste types.

WasteHunter.Title: How do I report an abandoned waste?
WasteHunter.Content:
How do I report an abandoned waste?
To report an abandoned waste, go to Report -> Report an abandoned waste. After taking the picture, optionally fill in the information about the waste and its category.

Notifications.Title: How can I see the notifications for my account?
Notifications.Content:
How can I see the notifications for my account?
To do this you need to be logged in by clicking on the button in the top right corner.

Complaints.Title: How can I make a complaint?
Complaints.Content:
How can I make a complaint?
Complaints can be submitted when you are logged in and have a valid address on your account by going to Profile -> Send a complaint.
